@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5SJQ62SPB7ZA9CC9H91TTB2
+- 01M5QWJGM1679S6CWHFCST7WAN
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9180'
+title: 'MTP: FoundationModels guided generation (schema and required tools) with the MTP drafter and grammar rollback'
+---
+## What
+Schema output (`runSchemaGeneration`) and required tool calls (`runRequiredToolTurn`) run `GuidedGenerationLoop.run` (Libraries/MLXGuidedGeneration or Libraries/MLXFoundationModels guided files; GuidedGenerationLoop.swift ~112-563). This loop is separate from `generateLoopTask`: it uses a new KV cache, no prompt cache (`carriesNoCache`, MLXLanguageModel.swift ~1666, ~2248), applies an xgrammar bitmask (`applyMaskAndSample` ~531-563) and always takes argmax. Thus guided output is greedy, and speculative sampling is not necessary here.
+
+The matcher is stateful for each token: `computeMask()` (XGrammarBridge.swift ~515) reads the current state, and `commitToken(_:fastForward:)` (~560-665) accepts a token and its forced jump-forward tokens. `rollback(n)` (~698-707) exists, and `n` must include the fast-forward acceptances; only tests use it (RollbackDeterminismTests, ForkIndependenceTests). Forced tokens are fed to the model one at a time (GuidedGenerationLoop.swift ~356-422); the comment at ~387-393 reports an MLX causal SDPA bug with T_q > 1 on a populated cache for Gemma 3.
+
+- [ ] Draft with the MTP drafter, masked by the grammar: get the mask for position 1, take the masked argmax of the drafter logits, `commitToken` it, and get the mask for position 2. Record the number of matcher acceptances (draft + fast-forward) for each draft.
+- [ ] Verify the drafts with one target forward pass, apply the mask of each position to the target logits, and accept while the masked target argmax equals the draft. On a rejection, `rollback` the matcher by the recorded count, commit the target token, and roll back the GDN state with the snapshot slots.
+- [ ] Put the forced fast-forward tokens into the same verify batch (they need no draft and are always accepted), but only for targets where T_q > 1 on a populated cache is proven correct (Qwen35 is; the scripted test must prove it). Keep the one-token feed for other targets.
+- [ ] Use the MTP path only when the target has a drafter; else keep the current loop unchanged.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] For the schemas in the GuidedGeneration tests and a required tool call, the output with MTP is byte-identical to the output without MTP, on the scripted Qwen35 + MTP fixture and on the real Qwen3.8 model.
+- [ ] After a rejected draft, the matcher state equals the state of a run without MTP at the same position (compare the next mask).
+- [ ] Real model: guided JSON generation tok/s with MTP > without MTP (add a case to GuidedGenerationBenchmarkTests).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/GuidedGenerationMTPTests.swift: equality, matcher rollback with and without fast-forward tokens, mask equality after rejection.
+- [ ] IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/GuidedGeneration/GuidedGenerationBenchmarkTests.swift: an MTP case that skips when the MTP head is not local.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` and the MLXFoundationModelsTests target pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #foundation-models #guided-generation
\ No newline at end of file

Doc that said schema/required-tool output decode plainly is updated (MLXSpeculativeDecoding, runRequiredToolTurn).
+    - The loop body is split into shared types: `GuidedDecisionRules` (mask + zone biases + stop rule per position, one place for plain, drafts and verify), `GuidedPosition`, `GuidedDecoder` (decide / accept-draft / emit / finish, same emission and stop order as before), `GuidedTarget` (prefill with optional drafter chunk feed, one-token feed, verify forward, in-place keep/rewind), `GuidedDraftChain` + `GuidedDraftProcessor` (LogitProcessor the drafter runs each step through: mask+bias, commit, acceptance count, next position; rollback by recorded counts), `GuidedSpeculation` (rounds).
+    - Gate: drafter is `ResumableMTPDrafterModel & StatefulMTPDistributionDrafterModel`, `!requiresSharedTargetKV`, compatible, and the target verifies in place (`MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.verifiesInPlace` / `drafts(_:fittingWindowOf:)`, made `package`). That is the Qwen35 hybrid set; every other target keeps the plain loop and its one-token feed. Forced tokens join the verify batch (or verify-shaped chunks of `maximumNativeTargetCacheRewind + 1`) only there; `aVerifyForwardOnAPopulatedCacheGivesTheOneTokenLogits` is the proof test on the Qwen35 fixture.
+    - Prefill: `speculation.prefillFeed` chunk handler + a new `MTPDrafterPrefillFeed.primedState(finalSegment:...)` (resume from the chunk boundary, else cold start) builds a new drafter state over the whole prompt.
+    - A draft that forces tokens, terminates the grammar, stops, or reaches the budget ends its chain (later drafts would need hidden rows of the forced tokens). After a rejection the matcher rolls back, `GuidedDecoder.restore` recomputes the matcher's mask (reuses the recorded mask array when equal), and the target decides there as plain does.
+    - Test-only sink fields: `decisions` (mask + bias per decision), `decisionMargins` (top-2 constrained gap per target decision), `draftedTokenCount` / `acceptedDraftTokenCount`, `rollbacks`.
+    - Mutation check: dropping the forced tokens from the rollback count fails the loop equality tests and the FF rollback unit test; the decision-trace test now runs over every schema so it catches it too.
+    - Results: all 5 bundles green (MLXLMTests 1988, MLXFoundationModelsTests 404, MLXGuidedGenerationTests 70, CXGrammarTests 7, MLXHuggingFaceMacrosTests 6). Release `qwen38GuidedJSONWithMTP` on Qwen3.8-27B-4bit + MTP-4bit (shipped blockSize 2): plain 54.05 tok/s, MTP 74.71 tok/s (+38%), output exact (no divergence), 27/32 drafts accepted, 64 tokens.
+    - Gotcha: `loadModelContainer` (testLoad) loads Qwen3.8 as the VLM model, and the `.qwen35Text` drafter then never drafts (0 drafts in the first benchmark run). The benchmark loads through `LLMModelFactory` like the other MTP benchmarks. Filed ^8hjz9t1.
+    - Follow-ups filed: ^ashrw1b (plain guided loop never feeds the sampled token when its commit fast-forwards; MTP reproduces it through the shared `modelFeed` so outputs stay identical), ^hg732qb (iterator's after-feed priming could call `primedState`).
+    - Shared decode/cache code: only an access-level change on two iterator statics and one additive feed method; no text-decode behaviour change, so the Qwen3.8 MTP regression guards were not re-run.
